description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Redshift::Snapshot. Creates a manual snapshot of the specified cluster. The cluster must be in the available state.

SnapshotArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot.
SnapshotArn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the snapshot.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:redshift:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:snapshot:[^:]+/[^:]+$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

SnapshotIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the snapshot that you are requesting. This identifier must be unique for all snapshots within the Amazon Web Services account.
SnapshotIdentifier.markdownDescription:
A unique identifier for the snapshot that you are requesting. This identifier must be unique for all snapshots within the Amazon Web Services account.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 255  
Update requires: Replacement

ClusterIdentifier.description: The cluster identifier for which you want a snapshot.
ClusterIdentifier.markdownDescription:
The cluster identifier for which you want a snapshot.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 63  
Update requires: Replacement

ManualSnapshotRetentionPeriod.description: The number of days that a manual snapshot is retained. If the value is -1, the manual snapshot is retained indefinitely. The value must be either -1 or an integer between 1 and 3653.
ManualSnapshotRetentionPeriod.markdownDescription:
The number of days that a manual snapshot is retained. If the value is -1, the manual snapshot is retained indefinitely. The value must be either -1 or an integer between 1 and 3653.

Required: No  
Type: Integer  
Update requires: No interruption

Status.description: The snapshot status. The value of the status depends on the API operation used: CreateClusterSnapshot and CopyClusterSnapshot returns status as creating. DescribeClusterSnapshots returns status as creating, available, final snapshot, or failed. DeleteClusterSnapshot returns status as deleted.
